description: Información Socioeconómica Áreas Urbanas Según Calles OSM is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía. Información socioeconómica de Áreas urbanas según las calles de OpenStreetMap Acceder a metodología. ISO 19126: EconomicCommercial, Este subgrupo se compone de conceptos que se relacionan con el comercio y / o economía. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía. Its tags are Información geográfica, OSM, Áreas urbanas. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
